subject: MAP: evaluation artifact exchange & limited-use timeline
messages:
From: Emma Ralston <emma@blueloom.ai>
To: grace_oconnor; marissa_cole
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: evaluation artifact exchange & limited-use timeline

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput and latency profiles you showed line up well with our production targets. As discussed, we'd like to move forward with a short evaluation: we want to share a ~25k example prompt pack + a redacted test corpus so your team can run end-to-end quality and cost checks.

Quick asks from our side so we can commit:
- A mutual action plan (MAP) with explicit dates for artifact delivery, sandbox access, and takedown.
- Constraints on how Redwood will use the assets (ephemeral eval only, no material retention beyond 90 days, no re-use for training).
- A simple acceptance test: 50 prompt / 500-response smoke run and a short regression checklist.

I've attached a draft prompt pack (see attachment) and a one-page outline of our expectations. Could you confirm the MAP timeline you need to get internal sign-off? We prefer a two-week window from handoff to acceptance testing.

Regards,
Emma
Emma Ralston
Head of ML Ops, Blueloom Labs
Attachments: Blueloom_eval_promptpack_v1.zip (zip)

---

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ralston <emma@blueloom.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole; karthik_iyer
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation artifact exchange & limited-use timeline

Emma — thanks for the clear note and the prompt pack. Per the demo notes, Redwood is comfortable with an ephemeral evaluation under constrained-use terms. I am looping in Marissa (data onramp) and Karthik (legal/MPA flows) so we can align on a MAP that covers delivery, acceptance, and takedown.

Draft responses / constraints:
- Redwood commitment: sandbox access in US-west within 3 business days of receiving the artifacts.
- Retention: artifacts will be held for 90 days post-delivery, then wiped from ephemeral storage and our caches.
- Training: Blueloom assets will not be used for model training, fine-tuning, or to improve shared models — we will enforce via restricted storage lanes and audit logs.
- Acceptance test: we can run the 50×500 smoke run and provide a tokenized cost and latency report plus sample outputs.

Action items for MAP v1:
1) Blueloom to confirm the final prompt pack + redaction level for the corpus (Emma/Theo).
2) Redwood to send a one-page MAP with milestones, responsibilities, and takedown checklist (Grace / Marissa).
3) Legal acceptance of the no-training clause and short retention window (Karthik).

We prefer to have the MAP signed off within three business days so we can schedule the sandbox slot next week. I'll attach a one-page MAP draft in my next email.

—Grace O'Connor
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Platform for high-performance LLM inference

---

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ralston <emma@blueloom.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor; karthik_iyer
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation artifact exchange & limited-use timeline

Emma — quick operational notes from the onramp side:
- File format: please send CSV (rows: prompt_id, prompt_text) for prompt pack and a separate redacted corpus tar.gz with a manifest. Avoid PII; if additional redactions remain we'll flag at ingestion.
- Sandbox access: we provision a temporary project and service account. We will provide a short runbook for the acceptance test (how to call routes, streaming vs non-streaming, expected tokenization).
- Audit & access: you will receive audit links showing object access and deletion events during the 90-day window.

Attachment: MAP_Draft_Grace_v1.docx (docx) — includes milestone dates and responsibilities. Summary from the draft:
Milestone A (Day 0): Blueloom delivers artifacts; Redwood verifies manifest and confirms ingestion (Day 1).
Milestone B (Day 2–5): Redwood runs smoke acceptance tests and shares latency/cost report (Day 5).
Milestone C (Day 6–14): Customer QA and short feedback window; optional follow-up snapshot (if issues).
Milestone D (Day 90): Scheduled takedown and deletion; preservation of audit logs for 180 days.

We will follow the no-training constraint as an enforceable clause in the MAP. If you need a 60-day instead of 90-day retention, note that in your reply and we'll surface to legal.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Data Platform Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_Draft_Grace_v1.docx

From: Theo Martinez <theo@blueloom.ai>
To: grace_oconnor; marissa_cole; karthik_iyer
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation artifact exchange & limited-use timeline

Thanks Grace / Marissa — this aligns with our expectations. Quick confirmations from Blueloom:
- We will deliver the final prompt pack (CSV) and a redacted corpus tar.gz by EOD Thursday (2025-06-19).
- Retention: we accept the 90-day retention with audit logs preserved for 180 days. No-training clause accepted.
- Acceptance window: Blueloom will target Day 0–14 as outlined; we reserve the right to request a single 3-day extension for customer QA if needed.

Attached is the final prompt pack v1 (zipped) and a pointer to our internal MPA tracker. We are ready for your MAP signature — please send the one-page MAP with milestone dates and we will route internally.

Regards,
Theo Martinez
Program Manager, Blueloom Labs
